=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
engineering_principles:
  - TypeScript strict mode everywhere (noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks)
  - React 18 functional components and hooks only, no class components
  - better-sqlite3 is synchronous — never async/await on DB calls
  - Emit wal_events for every state transition (drives SSE real-time UI and audit log)
  - WCAG AA accessibility — keyboard nav, ARIA labels, 4.5 contrast ratio minimum
  - Mobile responsive from 320px with 44px minimum touch targets

api_conventions:
  error_format: "always { error: string } — never expose stack traces"
  status_codes:
    - "400: validation failure"
    - "401: unauthenticated"
    - "403: unauthorized"
    - "404: not found"
    - "409: conflict (duplicate or active run)"
    - "422: semantically invalid"
    - "500: server error"
  dates: "ISO 8601 UTC. SQLite timestamps lack Z suffix — append before JS Date parsing"
  ids: "kebab-slug for user-facing IDs, numeric rowid for internal DB refs"
  pagination: "items array + total count + hasMore boolean + optional cursor"
  sse: "text/event-stream, 15s heartbeat, base64 chunks for binary-safe xterm output"

security:
  - HMAC-SHA256 for all incoming webhooks
  - Parameterized SQL queries only — never string interpolation
  - Sanitize and validate all user input at API boundaries
  - Rate limit public endpoints

testing_standards:
  backend: "in-memory SQLite for tests, mock LLM calls, test happy + error + edge"
  frontend: "mock apiFetch, test component behavior not implementation details"
  e2e: "Playwright for critical user journeys"

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
# Rorca — AI Spec Orchestration Platform

## Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite (:5210), Tailwind CSS, xterm.js
- Backend: Express.js, TypeScript, SQLite (better-sqlite3, WAL mode), tsx runner (:3030)
- Execution: `claude --print` (Claude sub) | `opencode run` (75+ models) | `codex` (ChatGPT sub)

## Architecture
Spec-driven development platform. Turns plain-English briefs into structured specs with N user stories, then executes each story as an isolated subprocess with full tool access.

### Direction Stack (5-layer context cascade)
- L1 Standards → L2 Conventions → L3 Project (editable)
- L4 Spec Brief → L5 Story Annotations (auto-populated at runtime)
- Lower layers override higher ones (CSS specificity model).

### Spec Lifecycle
`Spec Forge → Review Queue → Approved → Pipeline Run → Archive`

Spec files live in the project workspace at `forge/specs/pending/` and `forge/specs/approved/`.

## Key Constraints
- Backend has NO hot-reload. Must kill port 3030 and restart after changes.
- `spec.id` = filename slug (for paths). `spec.specName` = human title (display only).
- `chatComplete()` returns `ChatResult { text, usage }` — never treat as string.
- Auth middleware is intentionally disabled (single-user local tool).
- WAL events table uses `ts` column, NOT `created_at`.

## Navigation
4 main views: Spec (brief → generate), Wake (archive), Dive (pipeline monitor), Hub (overview).
Settings sidebar: Direction, Providers, GitHub, Shortcuts, Account, Billing.
